scope: Read the full Japanese article and all twelve translations. Checked current GitHub account access, supported IDEs, Marketplace installation, device-code authorization flow, inline suggestions, acceptance shortcut, Copilot Chat entry, metadata, and language parity.
findings: Replaced the old bottom-right icon authentication path with the current Tools > GitHub Copilot > Login to GitHub flow, followed by Copy and Open, device-code authorization, and the IDE confirmation.
Added Copilot access prerequisites and a note that plan limits, IDE compatibility, and UI labels can change.
Updated code suggestion guidance to say Tab accepts the inline suggestion and readers should review it before use.
Removed the old version-specific UI screenshots and their alt text from the article body so they no longer conflict with current UI instructions.
Removed duplicate date fields from all editions, retained the 2022-09-10 publication date, and set lastmod to 2026-11-24.

Removed duplicate lastmod front-matter keys from index.ar.md, index.de.md, index.en.md, index.es.md, index.fr.md, index.hi.md, index.id.md, index.ko.md, index.md, index.pt.md, index.ru.md, index.zh-cn.md, index.zh-tw.md; refreshed source/translation hashes to match these metadata-only revisions and set publication verification pending.

meaning.note: Prerequisites, installation, device-code sign-in, authorization, code suggestions, and Copilot Chat are aligned across all editions with current GitHub documentation.

terminology.note: GitHub Copilot, IntelliJ IDEA, plugin/Marketplace, device code, authorization, inline suggestions, Chat, and the English UI labels remain distinct and consistent.

links.note: All editions point to the current official GitHub install guide, official JetBrains code-suggestion instructions, and GitHub's JetBrains Marketplace listing.

limitations: AI-assisted review; no human or native-speaker certification.
